title: Allah loves to see His servants to be happy and grateful, not depressed, but
body:
masruran, ferhane, content with people

Allah loves to see His servants to be happy and grateful, not depressed, but masruran, ferhane, content with
people. Why people are not happy?
We are created as human beings, not as animals, but people are not happy with their Lord. Think about
people in hospitals, who are only breathing and fed through pipes…People don't take a lesson from what is
happening in Palestine. Think of Sayidinna Yusuf who was thrown into prison with injustice, who came out
and became the king. Think of all the favours of Allah towards you and thank Him, give Shukr. The Jews were
40 years in the desert as a punishment for their ungratefulness, going in circles…Gratefulness increases
Allah's favours.
The problem about learning is that one forgets when the brain is working by batteries. But if the servant
serves Allah for 40 days with sincerity, then Allah gives him wisdom on his tongue. Where is the knowledge
of Abu Bakr, who only transmitted 30-40 Hadith? He passed it on from heart to heart. In Islam there is no
'Doctor of Schariat'. That is a Jewish title. There are only Ulema.
Damaskus - 02.05.2002
